environment.description: Service deployed as an ECS Fargate task behind an Application Load Balancer with public internet access. The ALB forwards all traffic to the container on port 8080. No authentication layer is configured on the ALB or in front of the service. Kafka cluster is Amazon MSK in the same VPC. Any internet client can call /session/init and /session/elevate endpoints directly.

config.tls: ALB terminates TLS, no client cert
